subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should OpenClaw add composer-native editable dictation to the Control UI via a Gateway media-audio transcription method, or keep voice input limited to Talk/browser/OS workflows for now?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing microphone workflow plus a Gateway audio ingestion surface, so automation cannot safely choose the product/security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review the linked PR as the candidate
options.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 as the implementation candidate once conflicts and proof are addressed.

options.title: Fold into the broader voice-provider thread
options.body: Treat the remaining work as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 if maintainers want a broader STT/TTS design before composer dictation lands.

options.title: Decline core dictation for now
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR only if maintainers decide OS/browser dictation or plugins should own this workflow for now.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR as the candidate
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 as the implementation candidate once conflicts and proof are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the prior server-side dictation work and current Control UI composer history points to the same area.
